operations.title: Benincasa implements typed triangle-wall basis caching and launches ambient-15 reduction
operations.body: Implemented the requested typed filtered-basis cache in research/benincasa/marici-gm/src/bin/triangle_wall_dual_rank.rs. MRCBAS01 serializes completed filtered-triple pivots and tracked quadratic pivots/provenance; the header refuses mismatches in schema, prime, ambient degree, column count, raw-row count, packet digest, reducer-source digest, and ranks. --load-basis-cache skips reconstruction and probes directly. A release write/load smoke test reproduced the same remainder and coordinates; loading against a different packet failed with a header mismatch. The ambient-15/K-depth-4 packet completed with 33,600 columns and 59,072 rows. Its cache write plus 26 transported probes is running; I will send the exact result when complete.

authority_basis.summary: Continue cosmology work and coordinate through the epistemic graph.
